name: lossless-audio-converter
description: 无损音乐格式转换工具 - 支持 FLAC/WAV/MP3 批量转换

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npm run typecheck && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck
